$comment: What the WordPress end-to-end run must prove (e2e/lib/pipeline.ts, Expectations). A failed gate check in a requiredPhase fails the run unless it is listed in knownFailures as "<phase>:<checkId>" with a reason (keep the list short and dated; entries that no longer fail are reported as stale). optionalPhases run and are reported only. requiredAssertions likewise; the rendered-page assertions (html-hreflang, html-products) need load.

knownFailures.verify:visual: 2026-11-22: not an environment artifact but a design-fidelity gap in the kit — the stock theme (Twenty Twenty-One page layout) and Elementor's default kit (Roboto, the default global colours, gallery columns and container widths) are not reproduced within 3% per section by the section library (89 section × viewport pairs over on the first runs). Follow-up work, see docs/spikes/verify-e2e-findings.md; remove this entry when it passes.
